packages.line1: Three ways to keep the day.

cta.body: Dates in Bali fill quickly in the dry season (May–September). A short message is enough to start — we’ll reply within a day.

intro.title: The art of keeping a day, for the years after
intro.body: We photograph and film weddings, pre-weddings, events and personal stories across Bali. Quietly, without posing lists, and edited by hand — so what you receive feels like the day did, not like a catalogue of it.

invite.title: Tell us about your day
invite.body: Dates in Bali fill quickly in the dry season (May–September). A short message is enough to start — we reply within a day.

work.lead: A selection of weddings, sessions and events across Bali. Every set is edited by hand; nothing here is a preset.

services.lead: Photo, film, or both — every service below is shot by the same person, edited by hand, and delivered through a private gallery where you choose your favourites.

wedding.title: Wedding
wedding.body: From preparations to the last dance. We work quietly, without posing lists, and film the vows in full if you wish. Intimate ceremonies and elopements are welcome — sixty guests or six.

prewedding.title: Pre-wedding
prewedding.sub: A slow morning in the place you chose Bali for.
prewedding.body: Two to three hours, one or two locations — cliffs at Uluwatu, rice terraces in Sidemen, or the beach before anyone is awake. No props, no forced poses; we walk and talk.

event.title: Event
event.body: Corporate gatherings, launches, festivals and community celebrations. We cover the room, the speakers, and the moments between — delivered within 72 hours when you need them fast.
event.includes: Half-day or full-day · Optional same-day edit

personal.title: Personal
personal.body: Personal branding, graduation, family portraits. A relaxed session that ends with photographs you will actually use — on your profile, your wall, or your mother’s fridge.

packages.note: Prices exclude travel outside Bali and 11% tax. Custom coverage is always possible — tell us what matters and we will shape it.

faq.title: Things people ask before they ask.

items.q: How far in advance should we book?
items.a: For weddings in the dry season (May–September), 6–10 months. Sessions and events can often be arranged within a few weeks.
Yes — Lombok, Java and further on request. Travel and stay are quoted separately.

items.q: How do we receive the photographs?
items.a: Through a private online gallery where you pick your favourites. Final edits follow within 4–6 weeks for weddings, 10 days for sessions.

items.q: Can we get the RAW files?
items.a: No. Unedited files are not part of any package; the edit is the work.

items.q: Do you work with international couples?
items.a: Most of our wedding couples live abroad. We plan over video calls and WhatsApp, in English or Bahasa Indonesia.

about.lead: It is the reason this exists: not to make a beautiful picture of a day, but to make a day you can walk back into — ten years on, on a bad afternoon, with the people who were there and the ones who no longer are.
about.body: I photograph and film independently from Bali. There is no team behind the name yet; when you write to Lintas Waktu, you write to me, and I am the one who shows up. That is a limitation on how many days I can take in a year, and it is the point.

items.title: Present, not prominent
items.body: We stay close enough to see, far enough not to be seen. No posing lists, no shouting across the room.

items.title: Edited by hand
items.body: Every photograph is graded one by one. No AI batch edits, no presets sold as a look.

items.title: Yours to choose
items.body: You pick your favourites in a private gallery. We finish what you chose, not what we guessed.
